Without load/energy measurements or cross-validating temperature sensors, the observed single-sensor drift is equally consistent with (a) a genuine upward temperature change from increased local loads (more equipment/occupancy in the core, which we would expect to correlate with rising energy use), and (b) a progressive sensor bias. The monotonic, non-seasonal shape of the rise is suggestive of sensor drift, but a genuine gradual load shift is also compatible with the same shape. The available streams cannot distinguish the two.
